title: succisa pratensis var. ovalis
intro: Succisa pratensis var. ovalis, commonly known as Devil's-bit scabious, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Dipsacaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Devil's-bit scabious include its ability to relax muscles, reduce spasms, and act as a diuretic. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
